title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates wave speed as 20 m/s using distance from first to fifth buoy (40 m) and time interval (2 s).

title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates wavelength as 6 m using λ = vT with proper v and T values.

title: Period determination
description: Important: Student correctly determines period T = 0.3 s from the 10 oscillations in 3 seconds.

title: Distance interpretation
description: Important: Student correctly interprets that the wave travels from buoy 1 to buoy 5, covering 4 intervals (40 m total).

title: Wave equation application
description: Important: Student applies the fundamental wave relationship v = λ/T or λ = vT correctly.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units throughout calculations and includes units in final answers.

title: Incorrect distance count
description: Pitfall: Student mistakenly uses 5 intervals (50 m) instead of 4 intervals (40 m) for wave travel distance.

title: Period calculation error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly calculates period (e.g., using 2+3=5 seconds instead of 3 seconds for oscillation time).
